# Made in China Peptide

> B2B sourcing channel for research-grade peptides manufactured in China: batch-specific COA, HPLC/MS data, bulk and OEM supply for laboratories, distributors and research brands.

## Key pages
- /products/ — catalogue of research peptides and cosmetic raw materials
- /products/retatrutide/ — retatrutide research material, bulk and OEM supply
- /wholesale/ — wholesale and bulk ordering model, pricing factors, documentation
- /oem-private-label/ — OEM and private-label process, label rules
- /quality/ — QC framework, analytical methods, COA structure
- /quality/coa/ — how to read a peptide certificate of analysis
- /quality/testing-methods/ — HPLC, MS, Karl Fischer explained
- /factory/ — process chain and traceability framework
- /knowledge/ — sourcing and quality guides
- /knowledge/glp-1-research-peptides-compared/ — semaglutide vs tirzepatide vs retatrutide, analytical comparison
- /knowledge/peptide-counter-ion-forms/ — acetate vs TFA salt forms and peptide content
- /knowledge/peptide-endotoxin-bioburden/ — endotoxin vs bioburden, LAL methods, what to request
- /knowledge/peptide-solubility-troubleshooting/ — why a peptide will not dissolve, and the diagnostic order
- /knowledge/peptide-aggregation-self-assembly/ — aggregation vs sequence-directed self-assembly, detection and prevention
- /knowledge/peptide-packaging-configurations/ — vial vs bulk pack, headspace, desiccants and RFQ packaging fields
- /knowledge/peptide-specification-annex/ — the field list that makes a peptide limit testable, and the common omissions
- /knowledge/peptide-supplier-site-audit-questionnaire/ — printable 40-question site-audit checklist by quality/production/documentation/traceability
- /knowledge/remote-peptide-supplier-audit/ — document request list, video walkthrough script and a scoring rubric
- /knowledge/second-peptide-supplier-qualification/ — dual sourcing, parallel qualification lots and change control
- /knowledge/peptide-supplier-payment-terms/ — deposits, balance payments, L/C and escrow risk, bank-detail fraud checks
- /knowledge/peptide-lyophilization-explained/ — freeze-drying stages, residual moisture, cake defects and process questions
- /knowledge/reading-peptide-hplc-chromatograms/ — peak shape, integration choices, area% vs mass%
- /knowledge/peptide-ms-ms-sequence-confirmation/ — b/y ion sequencing, coverage maps, and what MS/MS cannot resolve
- /knowledge/peptide-mass-spec-identity/ — monoisotopic vs average mass, adducts and ppm error in MS identity checks
- /knowledge/peptide-sequence-notation/ — one-letter codes, residue mass arithmetic, terminal modifications and checking a catalogue MW
- /knowledge/peptide-stability-studies/ — real-time vs accelerated stability data, assay panel and stability-claim red flags
- /knowledge/peptide-degradation-pathways/ — hydrolysis, oxidation, deamidation, isomerisation and what a COA can detect
- /knowledge/peptide-residual-solvents/ — solvent residues from synthesis and purification, headspace GC and COA fields
- /knowledge/peptide-net-content-and-cost/ — fill weight vs peptide mass, salt and water correction, cost per mg
- /knowledge/peptide-sampling-and-batch-release/ — sampling plans, receipt testing, retain samples and OOS investigation
- /knowledge/peptide-purification-and-salt-conversion/ — preparative HPLC, fraction pooling, yield and counter-ion exchange
- /knowledge/peptide-aggregate-analytics/ — SEC, DLS, AUC and FTIR: what each aggregate method measures
- /knowledge/custom-peptide-synthesis-order/ — custom sequence orders: fields, difficulty drivers, scale basis
- /knowledge/analytical-method-validation/ — validation parameters, peptide-specific pitfalls and the questions to ask of a certificate
- /knowledge/peptide-buffer-selection/ — pH versus pI, buffer pKa, detection compatibility and co-solvent constraints
- /knowledge/peptide-inventory-and-retest-dates/ — safety stock, retest dates, quarantine and FIFO
- /knowledge/peptide-synthesis-impurities/ — synthesis-derived impurities, mass-shifted vs mass-silent, impurity statement fields
- /knowledge/peptides-in-cell-culture-assays/ — adsorption, serum binding, vehicle and readout interference in in-vitro work
- /tools/ — laboratory calculators
- /tools/reconstitution-calculator/ — mg/mL, molarity, dilution and aliquot math for lyophilized vials
- /tools/cost-per-mg-calculator/ — normalise quotations to cost per mg of peptide
- /tools/hplc-dilution-calculator/ — stock-to-working dilution, mass on column and serial dilution series
- /compliance/research-use-only/ — permitted and prohibited uses
- /compliance/shipping-customs/ — shipping, documentation, restricted destinations
- /contact/ — RFQ

## Notes
- All products are for laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.
- Purity is batch-specific and stated on each lot's COA.
